verdict.rationale: Highnote's own docs describe Collaborative Authorization, which lets you approve or decline transactions in real time based on your business logic. That covers the core of the story, but the pack gives no detail on how it works: no endpoint contract, no network time budget, and no timeout fallback you control. missing for 10: documented webhook/endpoint mechanism and response format for auth decisions, stated response-time budget, documented controllable timeout/stand-in fallback behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
